title: The pro-etale pushforward of the pullback of an etale sheaf is the pullback of the etale pushforward
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism f, the pro-etale pushforward of the pullback of an etale sheaf of sets (respectively an abelian sheaf) equals the pullback of the etale pushforward, and likewise for the higher direct images (statement lines 4912-4924). The proof (proof lines 4926-4965) reduces to an affine base and to objects that are limits of affine etale schemes, identifies both sides through the description of the pullback, and concludes with the computation of the cohomology of a directed colimit. H2: one reduction used twice with three inputs, written out in full.
